fs_pos.truth: full scan MS1, ESI+, unit resolution, LC, RT 0.51-20.01 min, 1111 scans, cycle 1.05 s, peak sigma 0.06 min (FWHM about 8.5 s)

fs_neg.truth: as fs_pos t0 in ESI-, every m/z 2.0146 lower

polalt.truth: full scan, positive and negative scans alternating in one file

ida.truth: DDA at unit resolution: one survey scan and two product-ion scans per cycle, CE 25

mrm_epi.truth: MRM 364.1>194.1 (Quant) and 364.1>152.1 (Qual) plus 20 product-ion scans triggered at RT 14.0-14.7

mrm_std.truth: MRM only, 7 samples and 6 standards; roles proposed from names

ms2.truth: product-ion scans of precursors 229.1 and 305.0, CE 10, many empty scans

hr.truth: Orbitrap DDA; Exploris HCD NCE 30 isolation 0.75, Fusion CID 35 ion trap MS2 isolation 1.5 and +3 ppm systematic MS1 error

hr_broken.truth: Orbitrap DDA without spectrumRef, isolation window, resolution or known model

trunc.truth: file cut at half its bytes: unreadable

sub.truth: parent 253.3 (RT 5.2) decays, product 301.3 (RT 6.4) appears, background 150.2 (RT 3.0) in every file including the blank, RT drift 0.05 min in t10 and t20, gain 1.3 in t20

qc.truth: series with 3 QC and 2 blanks, linear RT drift 0.05 min from first to last QC, contaminant only in blanks

dia.truth: one DIA file with fixed isolation windows
